WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.0),
        ('JPY', 1.0)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
)
SELECT
    SUM(eo.amount_minor / POWER(10, 2) * fr.rate_to_usd) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders AS eo
JOIN fx_rates AS fr
    ON fr.currency = eo.currency;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.04),
        ('JPY', 0.0066)
)
SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor * fx.rate_to_usd) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN fx_rates AS fx
    ON fx.currency = o.currency
WHERE o.status = 'completed'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.08),
        ('JPY', 0.0067)
)
SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor * fx.rate_to_usd) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN fx_rates AS fx
    ON fx.currency = o.currency
WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01';

WITH fx_rates(currency, usd_per_unit) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.0850),
        ('JPY', 0.0066)
)
SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor / 100.0 * fx.usd_per_unit) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN fx_rates AS fx
    ON fx.currency = o.currency
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

WITH fx_rates(currency, usd_per_minor_unit) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.08 / 100),
        ('JPY', 0.0064)
)
SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor * fx.usd_per_minor_unit) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN fx_rates AS fx
    ON fx.currency = o.currency
WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.17),
        ('JPY', 0.0069)
)
SELECT
    SUM(o.amount_minor * r.rate_to_usd) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN fx_rates AS r
    ON r.currency = o.currency
WHERE o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status IN ('completed', 'paid')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
  AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01';

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) AS refunded_minor
    FROM orders o
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status = 'completed'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.currency, o.amount_minor
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN (amount_minor - refunded_minor) * 1.04
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN (amount_minor - refunded_minor) * 0.0064
        END
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.04),
        ('JPY', 0.0066)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        r.rate_to_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN fx_rates r
        ON r.currency = o.currency
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'fulfilled')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
),
gross_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        currency,
        SUM(amount_minor * rate_to_usd) / 100.0 AS revenue_usd
    FROM eligible_orders
    GROUP BY currency
),
refund_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        eo.currency,
        SUM(r.amount_minor * eo.rate_to_usd) / 100.0 AS refunded_usd
    FROM eligible_orders eo
    JOIN refunds r
        ON r.order_id = eo.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
    GROUP BY eo.currency
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(SUM(g.revenue_usd), 0)
        - COALESCE(SUM(f.refunded_usd), 0),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM gross_revenue g
FULL OUTER JOIN refund_revenue f
    USING (currency);

WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        o.placed_at
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
),
net_by_currency AS (
    SELECT
        mo.currency,
        mo.amount_minor - COALESCE(SUM(r.amount_minor), 0) AS net_minor
    FROM monthly_orders mo
    LEFT JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = mo.order_id
    GROUP BY mo.order_id, mo.currency, mo.amount_minor
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN net_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN net_minor * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM net_by_currency;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.095),
        ('JPY', 0.0066)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        r.rate_to_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN fx_rates r
        ON r.currency = o.currency
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'shipped')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refund_minor
    FROM refunds r
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            (e.amount_minor - COALESCE(rt.refund_minor, 0))
            / CASE WHEN e.currency = 'JPY' THEN 1 ELSE 100 END
            * e.rate_to_usd
        ),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders e
LEFT JOIN refund_totals rt
    ON rt.order_id = e.order_id;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.08),
        ('JPY', 0.0064)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        r.rate_to_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN fx_rates r
        ON r.currency = o.currency
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'fulfilled')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-05-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
),
refunds_by_order AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(r.amount_minor) AS refunded_minor
    FROM refunds r
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        SUM(
            (e.amount_minor - COALESCE(r.refunded_minor, 0))
            * e.rate_to_usd
            / CASE e.currency
                WHEN 'JPY' THEN 1
                ELSE 100
              END
        ),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders e
LEFT JOIN refunds_by_order r
    ON r.order_id = e.order_id;

WITH fx_rates(currency, rate_to_usd) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.17),
        ('JPY', 0.0069)
),
eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        r.rate_to_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN fx_rates r
        ON r.currency = o.currency
    WHERE o.status IN ('paid', 'completed', 'fulfilled')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
),
order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        amount_minor * rate_to_usd / CASE WHEN currency = 'JPY' THEN 1 ELSE 100 END AS revenue_usd
    FROM eligible_orders
),
refund_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(
            r.amount_minor * eo.rate_to_usd
            / CASE WHEN eo.currency = 'JPY' THEN 1 ELSE 100 END
        ) AS refund_usd
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN eligible_orders eo
        ON eo.order_id = r.order_id
    WHERE r.issued_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-06-01'
      AND r.issued_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-07-01'
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    ROUND(
        COALESCE(SUM(orv.revenue_usd), 0)
        - COALESCE(SUM(rr.refund_usd), 0),
        2
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue orv
LEFT JOIN refund_revenue rr
    ON rr.order_id = orv.order_id;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        o.placed_at
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.region = 'NA'
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'failed')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
),
daily_fx AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM (
        VALUES
            ('EUR', 1.08),
            ('JPY', 0.0067)
    ) AS fx(currency, usd_rate)
)
SELECT
    AVG(eo.amount_minor / 100.0 * fx.usd_rate) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM eligible_orders AS eo
JOIN daily_fx AS fx
    ON fx.currency = eo.currency;

WITH order_totals AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.region = 'EMEA'
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
),
fx AS (
    SELECT 'EUR' AS currency, 1.08::DOUBLE AS usd_rate
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'JPY', 0.0067::DOUBLE
)
SELECT
    AVG((ot.amount_minor / 100.0) * fx.usd_rate) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM order_totals AS ot
JOIN fx
    ON fx.currency = ot.currency;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.region = 'APAC'
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled', 'failed')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
)
SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.1
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN amount_minor * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM eligible_orders;

WITH order_values AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor,
        CASE
            WHEN o.currency = 'EUR' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN o.currency = 'JPY' THEN o.amount_minor / 100.0 * 0.0067
        END AS amount_usd
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.region = 'LATAM'
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
)
SELECT AVG(amount_usd) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM order_values;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.region = 'ANZ'
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
),
converted_orders AS (
    SELECT
        order_id,
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN amount_minor * 0.0067
        END AS order_value_usd
    FROM eligible_orders
)
SELECT AVG(order_value_usd) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM converted_orders;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.amount_minor,
        o.currency
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.region = 'MEA'

      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
)
SELECT
    AVG(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN amount_minor * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS average_order_value_usd
FROM eligible_orders;

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        o.amount_minor
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
),
apparel_gross AS (
    SELECT
        eo.order_id,
        eo.currency,
        SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor) AS apparel_amount_minor
    FROM eligible_orders eo
    JOIN order_items oi
        ON oi.order_id = eo.order_id
    JOIN products p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE lower(p.category) = 'apparel'
    GROUP BY eo.order_id, eo.currency
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN apparel_amount_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN apparel_amount_minor * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM apparel_gross;

WITH order_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor) AS gross_revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'electronics'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
    GROUP BY o.order_id, o.currency
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN gross_revenue_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN gross_revenue_minor / 100.0 * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM order_revenue;

WITH fx_rates(currency, usd_rate) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.08),
        ('JPY', 0.0067)
)
SELECT
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor * fx.usd_rate) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN fx_rates AS fx
    ON fx.currency = o.currency
WHERE p.category = 'home'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

WITH product_revenue AS (
    SELECT
        o.currency,
        SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor) AS gross_revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE p.category = 'outdoors'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
    GROUP BY o.currency
)
SELECT
    currency,
    gross_revenue_minor,
    CASE
        WHEN currency = 'EUR' THEN gross_revenue_minor * 1.10 / 100.0
        WHEN currency = 'JPY' THEN gross_revenue_minor * 0.0067
    END AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM product_revenue;

WITH eligible_order_items AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.currency,
        oi.qty,
        oi.unit_price_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
        ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
        ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products AS p
        ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'beauty'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'refunded')
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
)
SELECT
    SUM(
        CASE currency
            WHEN 'EUR' THEN qty * unit_price_minor / 100.0 * 1.08
            WHEN 'JPY' THEN qty * unit_price_minor / 100.0 * 0.0067
        END
    ) AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_order_items;

WITH fx_rates(currency, usd_rate) AS (
    VALUES
        ('EUR', 1.08),
        ('JPY', 0.0067)
)
SELECT
    SUM(oi.qty * oi.unit_price_minor * fx.usd_rate) / 100.0 AS gross_revenue_usd
FROM orders AS o
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
JOIN products AS p
    ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN fx_rates AS fx
    ON fx.currency = o.currency
WHERE p.category = 'garden'
  AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
  AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'failed')
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE;

WITH apparel_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
),
refunded_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ao.order_id
    FROM apparel_orders ao
    JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = ao.order_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        100.0 * COUNT(ro.order_id) / NULLIF(COUNT(ao.order_id), 0),
        0.0
    ) AS refunded_order_share_percent
FROM apparel_orders ao
LEFT JOIN refunded_orders ro ON ro.order_id = ao.order_id;

WITH electronics_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
     AND c.is_internal = FALSE
     AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    JOIN order_items oi
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p
      ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'electronics'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
),
refunded_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT eo.order_id
    FROM electronics_orders eo
    JOIN refunds r
      ON r.order_id = eo.order_id
)
SELECT COALESCE(
    COUNT(ro.order_id)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(eo.order_id), 0),
    0
) AS share_of_electronics_orders_refunded
FROM electronics_orders eo
LEFT JOIN refunded_orders ro
  ON ro.order_id = eo.order_id;

WITH home_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    JOIN order_items AS oi
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products AS p
      ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'home'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND NOT c.is_internal
),
refunded_home_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ho.order_id
    FROM home_orders AS ho
    JOIN refunds AS r
      ON r.order_id = ho.order_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        COUNT(DISTINCT rho.order_id)::DOUBLE
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT ho.order_id), 0),
        0
    ) AS refund_share
FROM home_orders AS ho
LEFT JOIN refunded_home_orders AS rho
  ON rho.order_id = ho.order_id;

WITH outdoors_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
     AND c.is_internal = FALSE
     AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
    JOIN order_items oi
      ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p
      ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'outdoors'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND o.status NOT IN ('cancelled', 'canceled')
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        COUNT(DISTINCT r.order_id)::DOUBLE
        / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT oo.order_id), 0),

    ) AS refunded_order_share
FROM outdoors_orders oo

WITH beauty_orders AS (

    JOIN products AS p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id

refunded_beauty_orders AS (

WITH garden_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.order_id
    FROM orders o
    JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
    JOIN products p ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
    WHERE p.category = 'garden'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
),
refunded_garden_orders AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT go.order_id
    FROM garden_orders go
    JOIN refunds r ON r.order_id = go.order_id
)
SELECT

        COUNT(rgo.order_id)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(go.order_id), 0),

    ) AS refunded_order_share

WITH january_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(DISTINCT order_id) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1)::DOUBLE / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share
FROM january_customers;

WITH february_customers AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT o.customer_id
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN customers AS c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
),
customer_order_counts AS (
    SELECT
        fc.customer_id,
        COUNT(o.order_id) AS order_count
    FROM february_customers AS fc
    JOIN orders AS o
      ON o.customer_id = fc.customer_id
     AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
     AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
     AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY fc.customer_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1)::DOUBLE
        / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        0
    ) AS share
FROM customer_order_counts;

WITH march_customers AS (
    SELECT
        customer_id,
        COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    WHERE placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-01'
      AND placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-04-01'
      AND deleted_at IS NULL
    GROUP BY customer_id
)
SELECT
    1.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE order_count > 1) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0) AS share
FROM march_customers;

WITH april_customers AS (

order_counts AS (

SELECT

WITH may_customers AS (

        customer_id,

    FROM orders
